info.name: Amoria : Circle of Trust 2 (A Bond is Forged)

descriptions.notStarted: An unhappy couple in Amoria? I should go find out what's wrong...
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with Gary and Shatima, and it looks like their rings were broken and taken in to #b20 Ring Fragments#k by some Tweeters. When I have them all, I am going to head over to Moony.
descriptions.completed: I returned to the Ring fragments to Moony, and now Gary and Shatima can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!
